notes: Nigerian government identity commission. Issues NIN (National Identification Number) and operates the National Identity Database. Includes biometric data and authentication services.

data.notes: Mandatory for SIM registration, banking, voter registration in Nigeria. Participant rules and Information Security Audit guidelines for accredited Front End Partners (FEPs) are partly restricted.

_country_provenance.note: Not verified against the organisation itself. A ccTLD implies where a domain was registered, not necessarily where the body operates — correct this field directly if it is wrong, and it will not be overwritten.
